article.headline: UMass-Lowell opens the season with a 121-57 win over Rivier
article.description: — Jasiah Cannady had 16 points in UMass-Lowell’s 121-57 win over Rivier on Monday, helping the River Hawks start the season with a victory.
article.linkText: UMass-Lowell opens the season with a 121-57 win over Rivier

event.description: Rivier Raiders @ UMass Lowell River Hawks

keywords: Rivier Raiders @ UMass Lowell River Hawks
article.story: LOWELL, Mass. -- — Jasiah Cannady had 16 points in UMass-Lowell’s 121-57 win over Rivier on Monday, helping the River Hawks start the season with a victory. Cannady added seven assists. Elhadji Diallo added 14 points while shooting 5 for 7 from the field and 4 for 8 from the line, and grabbed seven rebounds. Jakai Newton had 13 points and shot 5 for 5 from the field and 3 for 6 from the line. Matt Youngquist finished with 15 points for the Raiders. Rivier also got 11 points from Theo Briscoe IV. Steph Barnes added 10 points. Up next UMass-Lowell visits Merrimack on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
